title: Relationship Manager Trainee - SME Banking

questions: The posting asks for an investment consultant licence (IC). Can you get it before the start date?

reasons.love: Partly commercial; much of the role is back-office support.
reasons.good_at: Some overlap via F26 (reporting); the domain experience the JD wants is not evidenced.
reasons.needs: Established company with formal training for graduates.
reasons.paid: Estimate: the posting states no salary. about THB 30,000-40,000 per month. for a comparable Bangkok graduate role.

summary: Strong fit on role and growth; confirm the open questions before applying.
jd_text: Krungsri (Bank of Ayudhya) is hiring for Relationship Manager Trainee - SME Banking in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
